content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰 (Still looking for 1-2 more as of recent update). Contact: reply or DM with portfolio/pricing/availability.

author: Creative Leads Community
title: Freelance 3D Character Artist & Animator wanted for indie game

Compensation is $15 USD/hour for up to 8 hours per week, starting with a 30-day paid contract. Remote applicants worldwide may be considered. Contact: via creativeleadscommunity.com or as specified in post.
